meta.name: accessibility-review
meta.description: Use to audit a design or page for WCAG 2.1 AA — contrast, keyboard, focus, labels, touch targets, screen reader behavior.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计页面或设计是否符合无障碍标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保产品对残障用户友好
copy.tagline_en: Audit pages or designs for accessibility standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your product is accessible to users with disabilities

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据 WCAG 2.1 AA 标准审查设计或网页，检查对比度、键盘操作、焦点、标签、触摸目标和屏幕阅读器行为，并输出详细报告（问题总数、严重程度、WCAG准则、建议修正等）。
howto.when: 当用户要求审核设计或网页的无障碍性时触发，特别是提到WCAG、无障碍、对比度、键盘导航等关键词。

say.text: 帮我审核这个网页设计的无障碍性，按WCAG 2.1 AA标准。
检查这几个按钮的对比度和触摸目标尺寸。
say.note: 显示具体元素的对比度数据和建议。

say.text: 用键盘走一遍这个页面，看焦点顺序是否合理。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude audits a design or page against WCAG 2.1 AA — checking contrast, keyboard, focus, labels, touch targets, and screen reader behavior. It outputs a detailed report with issue count, severity, WCAG criteria, and recommended fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to audit a design or page for accessibility, especially mentioning WCAG, contrast, keyboard navigation, etc.

say_en.text: Audit this web page design for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
Check the contrast and touch target size of these buttons.
Keyboard-walk through this page and check focus order.
